app.workspace.localhost -> HTTP 502, 157 bytes
cms.workspace.localhost -> HTTP 502, 157 bytes
boards.workspace.localhost -> HTTP 502, 157 bytes
=== title of app response ===
<title>502 Bad Gateway</title>

observation.command: for a in app cms boards; do code=$(curl -s -o /tmp/resp_$a.html -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 60 -H "Host: ${a}.workspace.localhost" http://127.0.0.1:80/ 2>&1); size=$(wc -c < /tmp/resp_$a.html 2>/dev/null); echo "${a}.workspace.localhost -> HTTP ${code:-timeout}, ${size:-0} bytes"; done; echo "=== title of app response ==="; grep -oE "<title>[^<]*</title>" /tmp/resp_app.html 2>/dev/null | head -2
